conversion.title: CSV to JSON
conversion.description: CSV is read in the browser and can become an array of objects or an array of arrays.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Duplicate and empty headers get deterministic names so data is preserved.

delimiters.title: Delimiters
delimiters.description: Comma, semicolon, tab, and pipe are supported, with optional automatic detection.

types.title: Values as strings
types.description: By default, everything stays text to preserve leading zeros, codes, phone numbers, and IDs.

jsonCsv.title: JSON to CSV
jsonCsv.description: Arrays of objects, arrays of arrays, and fields/data become tabular CSV.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Input is not added to the automatically saved link; shared content uses only the URL fragment.

privacy.question: Is CSV sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. Conversion runs in the browser. Selected files are read locally through the browser File API.

delimiter.question: Why did my semicolon CSV not convert?
delimiter.answer: Automatic detection is a heuristic. If the spreadsheet uses semicolons, select that delimiter manually.

headers.question: How do duplicate headers become JSON keys?
headers.answer: The first occurrence keeps the original name. Later ones get suffixes such as _2, and empty headers become column_N.

strings.question: Why are numbers strings by default?
strings.answer: This avoids changing IDs, postal codes, phone numbers, leading-zero codes, and values that look numeric but are identifiers.

nested.question: Does the tool accept nested JSON?
nested.answer: It expects tabular data. Nested cell values are serialized as JSON text and produce a warning.

formula.question: How do I avoid formulas when opening CSV in spreadsheets?
formula.answer: Enable formula escaping. It adds an apostrophe to suspicious cells, but that changes the exported text.

sharing.question: Can I share a prefilled CSV?
sharing.answer: Yes, only by checking the option to include input. Do not use it for tokens, credentials, personal data, or private datasets.

seo.about: The converter turns CSV into JSON and tabular JSON into CSV directly in the browser. It uses a CSV parser to handle quotes, delimiters, line breaks, UTF-8 BOM, and rows with different field counts.
seo.howToUseTitle: How to convert CSV to JSON
seo.howToUse: Paste or import a local file, choose the mode, adjust delimiter and headers, then copy or download the output. Shared links preserve only settings by default.
